1527427.title: Three Millimeters to You

Just before summer vacation, Yoon-seul, an exchange student from Busan, joins his class. As they grow closer, Tatsuhiko gradually discovers the heartfelt reason she chose this small Japanese town. However, an innocent remark unexpectedly hurts Yoon-seul, and she abruptly returns to Korea. Unable to let go of his regret, Tatsuhiko makes a life-changing decision—to cross the sea in search of the girl he never truly had the chance to understand.

1546947.title: Mary Kwon Mary Kwon

The film Prayer, which explores the intersection of tradition, fatherhood, and the struggles of undocumented immigrant labor, is based on the autobiographical story of its screenwriter, Deo Mahameru. 1692419.trailerName: OFFICIAL TRAILER 5 BOMOH | DI PAWAGAM 4 JUN 2026

1694531.trailerName: MESDAMES THANH SẮC | MAIN TRAILER | KHỞI CHIẾU TẠI RẠP: 19.06.2026

Amid society’s misunderstandings and everyday struggles, their relationship reflects love, acceptance, sacrifice, and the strength of family, creating a touching and inspiring tale about embracing individuality.
1696131.trailerName: PARVATI || Movie Official Teaser 2026 || Neeta Dhungana Adhikari, Ashok Darji, Deepa Shree Niraula,

1698115.title: In Pieces: The Musical (A Staged Concert)

Written and composed by Fred Ebb Award and Jonathan Larson Grant Finalist, Joey Contreras, In Pieces is a bold, contemporary new musical featuring a pop-driven score that dives into echoes of love, loss, and self-discovery by weaving the romantic journeys of six characters across three chapters of life. As friends, family, and former lovers confront old wounds and unresolved feelings, will they learn to coexist with the joy and pain of the past?  In Pieces has become a global sensation with a massive social media fanbase, tens of millions of streams, and licensed productions internationally. NOW, you can experience the staged concert from home for a limited time only.

Through the eyes of journalist and actor Swapnesh Dubey, the film weaves a powerful narrative, combining his coming-out journey with voices from across India. This multilingual documentary doesn’t look outward for validation, it looks inward, reclaiming a forgotten truth: that queerness in Indian culture was once revered, not erased. It confronts colonial hangovers, societal silences, and the class and language divides that shape who gets to participate in the national conversation.

1702787.title: Long Ago
1702787.overview: A story of long, long ago. When the world was just beginning.

1703619.title: Gentian Sprite
1703619.overview: Portrait of the elderly botanist Margaret Bradshaw

1705667.title: The War Game at Cinecity
1705667.overview: When Peter Watkins’ banned nuclear war masterpiece "The War Game" reached Toronto in 1967, it found an unlikely home at Cinecity, a new cinema determined to challenge audiences. Drawing on archival research and eyewitness accounts, this documentary explores the film’s enduring impact and the role Cinecity played in shaping Canadian film culture.

1705859.title: The Deliverer
1705859.overview: Facundo is an eccentric man with a variety of jobs and interests, but few people remember one of his greatest talents. After years of being sidelined in the industry, he receives a call with an offer he can’t refuse. He’ll become The Deliverer once again.

1707779.title: The Hunter and The Hunted
1707779.overview: Two boys rustle the feathers of a ruthless hunter and find themselves in an intense chase that will test their teamwork and will to survive.

1708611.title: Starlight & You
1708611.overview: Lily and Peter is a modern romantic drama about timing, connection, and love tested by real life. When a quiet online connection pulls two people together, distance, delay, and unexpected loss challenge what they're building. As they choose to show up for one another, their bond deepens into a love shaped by family values, resilience, and emotional truth. Warm, intimate, and universally relatable, Lily and Peter is a character-driven love story made for audiences who believe the strongest romances are earned.

1708867.title: Last stop for the circular ticket
1708867.overview: Around Lake Como, a voyage interrupted by a series of brief, successive stops, as fleeting as musical phrases. Someone enters and leaves a telephone booth. Water and the lines that contain it.

1709443.title: A Place Like Home
1709443.overview: A son reconstructs his childhood home in a film studio to understand why his family fell apart. Can one change their fate by reliving the past?

1711107.title: Dead Calm
1711107.overview: A short film about Men's Mental Health awareness.

1711811.title: The First Class Cadet
1711811.overview: When a brilliant 12-year-old aviation enthusiast gets an unexpected chance to test her skills in a real flight simulator, she must lead a panicked cabin through a sudden crisis and prove that heroism has no age limit.

1712067.title: Freedom Follows Me
1712067.overview: A 31 year old working woman named Zaila Wafford fights for change and the equality of women and men in the labor workforce and this will not just change her life but everyone's forever.

1712451.title: Resident Dead
1712451.overview: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.
1712451.trailerName: RESIDENT DEAD || Official Trailer || The Asylum Movie Channel

1712643.title: One word, not two
1712643.overview: In December of 2024, Hrvoje Turković sent Kino klub Osijek a notice – kinoklub is written as one word, not two.

1712707.title: In a Puddle
1712707.overview: At a decaying bus stop, a Girl falls into a puddle and finds there the love of her life.

1715139.title: Colors
1715139.overview: Different colors moving into harmony of Children's Corner, L. 113: IV. The snow Is dancing.

1715459.title: Mudharkanal
1715459.overview: A brilliant teenager destined for greatness loses everything to drug addiction after one wrong friendship. When he gets a final chance to rebuild his life, he must confront the consequences of his past before they consume his future.

1715779.title: Zenón and the Rebel Boats
1715779.overview: After being displaced from his home by the U.S. Navy to build a military base, Puerto Rican fisherman Carlos “Taso” Zenón pledged his life to fight against the military occupation of the island of Vieques. Alongside Puerto Rican fishermen and activists, Zenón organized countless efforts to halt U.S. war games in the Caribbean Sea. Never-before-seen archival footage reveals the artisanal strategies implemented by fearless fishermen to defy warships, inspiring one of the most influential environmental and anti-war movements in the Caribbean.

1718403.title: Mahjong Madness
1718403.overview: A quiet family mahjong game slowly descends into chaos.

1721347.title: RESET
1721347.overview: Lost in a remote winter forest, a woman struggles to escape an unseen force that quietly reshapes reality, trapping her in an endless cycle where every step forward leads her back to where she began.

1723395.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 4
1723395.overview: The fourth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 21, 2026, at Sendai Sun Plaza Hall in Sendai, Miyagi, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Shingo Takagi and Oleg Boltin.

1724931.title: Bergamot
1724931.overview: A surreal, experimental look at place, memory and internal conflict.

1725187.title: Masterni
1725187.overview: A girl goes missing, leaving the nation in shock as every lead goes cold.
1725187.trailerName: MASTERNI || Movie Trailer 2026 || Ayanka Films || Priyanka Karki, Simran Khadka, Aaryan, Pramod

1726851.title: Still Ohio
1726851.overview: Desperate to salvage her relationship, a college student embarks on a cross-country carpool only to find herself trapped in a haunting time loop where each stop at a lonely Ohio gas station grows more terrifying than the last.

1727107.title: No More Punk Time
1727107.overview: A documentary chronicling the history and final days of the Crayola House, a legendary DIY punk venue in Harrisonburg, Virginia. Through archival footage, live performances, and interviews with musicians, artists, and former residents, the film captures the spirit of a community built on music, creativity, and collective resistance as it faces displacement and the end of an era.

1727619.title: 2nd Miracle in Cell No.7
1727619.overview: Before the events of Miracle in Cell No. 7, a devoted father fights to protect his family after a tragedy leads to a custody battle.

1729667.title: Small Talk
1729667.overview: Hoping to launch a career in the luxury world, Charlie enrolls at the last finishing school in Switzerland. Over the course of a summer, women from around the world learn the codes of elegance, etiquette and conversation meant to prepare them for elite social circles. As they refine their gestures and manners, a world of aspiration, discipline and self-transformation gradually unfolds.

1734147.title: DAU
1734147.overview: Inspired by the physicists who built the Soviet atomic bomb, the film DAU follows a brilliant Greek-born physicist from 1928 through four tumultuous decades in the USSR. Driven to uncover the laws of the universe, the idealistic Dau is drawn into state service to help create one of history’s deadliest weapons. Inside a secret research institute, life is governed by scientific ambition, power, surveillance and privilege. As his autonomy erodes, Dau seeks freedom beyond his marriage through a succession of affairs, gradually losing both himself and his capacity to love. At once an intimate portrait of a man in pursuit of happiness and freedom and a vast fresco of a society founded on violence and ideology, DAU traces the small compromises that shape a life and alter the course of history.

1735107.title: Zrugg
1735107.overview: After an attack on a farmer's livestock, an obsessive wildlife officer is sent out to hunt down and kill the problematic wolf.

1735299.title: The Egotist
1735299.overview: Poor and tired, Amaro finds himself in the need of moving. Along the way he takes part in conversations that make him reflect on his changing position in society and on the anxieties of a young adult.

1736195.title: The House
1736195.overview: For decades, Gabriel García Márquez envisioned a novel titled La Casa (The House), inspired by the home in Aracataca where he lived with his grandparents. Fragments emerged, but it was only after living in another house —in Mexico City— that he was able to develop the work that became Cien años de soledad (One Hundred Years of Solitude), his magnum opus. In this documentary directed by Eva Villaseñor, the writer’s sons, Rodrigo and Gonzalo García Barcha, return to their childhood home—a place where memory transforms time.

1736323.title: Salvation
1736323.overview: A tenacious aspiring guru must go to extreme measures to pay off the debts he’s accrued from trying, and failing, to set up an online life-coaching business in a post-industrial Scottish town.  Exploring the world of male influencer culture and how it might be affecting the young men who come into its orbit, SALVATION blends mounting tension, dark comedy and a forensic focus on its protagonist to explore the very modern story of a delusional life coach spiralling out of control.

1739587.title: The Sick Mind of EDP445
1739587.overview: The downfall of the controversial internet figure Bryant Moreland, known as EDP445, after a 2021 online sting operation involving a 13-year-old changed the course of his life.
1739587.trailerName: The Sick Mind of EDP445 | Official Documentary Trailer

1740803.title: The Widowmaker
1740803.overview: Mechanical engineer Aiko Hoshino investigates the mysterious death of her brother, uncovering a deadly conspiracy surrounding an experimental system known as SHURA.

1741635.title: VILLAIN
1741635.overview: Home for winter break, Clyde asks his estranged brother, Sean, to reunite with the family for Christmas Eve dinner. The table is set, and still, no response.

1742211.title: AGAIN
1742211.overview: After having her proverbial third eye opened by the strange man who calls himself The Great Opticisioner, Evie Narmer is able to see directly into her past lives. Proving two things: reincarnation is real, but also that her past lives were awful. One of them in particular depicts an awful cult that she thus writes a deep and detailed novel on. Unexpectedly, the last surviving original member catches wind of this novel, and reignites the flame that cult once had. Now, that old man and Evie are at odds. What will happen next? Watch and find out.

1744003.title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
1744003.overview: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.
1744003.trailerName: Official First Trailer: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives

1745603.title: Peregrine Falcon
1745603.overview: Two young female serial killers take refuge in an abandoned warehouse to plot their next move. As one of the girls struggles with her role as the de facto leader, the other strives to prove her devotion as a follower.

1747139.title: The House Call
1747139.overview: Called in the middle of the night to treat a sick horse, a young equine veterinarian is faced with a series of unlikely encounters.

1748995.title: The Banquet
1748995.overview: With her personal life falling apart, an ad executive is reluctantly pushed by her fiery mother into the one challenge she never thought she’d have to take on: her family’s annual Chuseok (Korean Thanksgiving) celebration.

1752515.title: Adrenalina
1752515.overview: A doctor who hides a criminal compulsion.

1754947.title: Christmas Wrapped in Love
1754947.overview: Natasha Lloyd has built a unique business helping clients locate thoughtful, one-of-a-kind gifts for the people they love. When overworked surgeon Ryan Bartlett finds himself tasked with purchasing meaningful Christmas gifts for his entire family, he hires Natasha for help. To uncover the perfect presents, Natasha agrees to pose as Ryan’s girlfriend and spend the holiday season getting to know his family. What begins as a professional arrangement soon becomes something much more as Natasha discovers the true meaning of family, belonging, and love at Christmas.

1755331.title: Switch Over
1755331.overview: A winter in motion. After Monday comes Friday. Switch over. People move around, but I stay still. Switch over. A distant smile. After Wednesday comes Sunday. Switch over. Everything is close by. Why don’t you look up? Switch off.

1759875.title: The Militia
1759875.overview: Daniel Pierce dreams of joining the local Militia alongside his father once he turns eighteen, but when his Dad becomes the target of the local Sheriff, Daniel and his friends form their own militia in a troubled effort to save him.

1765955.title: Operation Hummingbird
1765955.overview: Yang Dong, a Hummingbird security officer, and his daughter are escorting Chinese nationals home when a mysterious attack shrinks the soldiers to miniature size. The tiny squad must lead the refugees to safety and uncover the truth behind it.

1766531.title: TV Land
1766531.overview: After being diagnosed with a terminal illness, Will is given a second chance at life when a disturbed doctor forces him into an experimental procedure. He awakens in a strange world hidden behind a television screen, where reality and fantasy blur together. As he searches for a way back home, Will is forced to confront his past and discover what truly gives life meaning.

1768387.title: Un train peut en cacher un autre [Marcel ! (I, II, III, IV)]
1768387.overview: Film performance involving one super-8 projector and three 16mm projectors screening choreographically the four films that compose up to date the series Marcel !, produced from 2021 to 2025 between Brussels and Madrid. This project takes as its point of departure the exhibition Poèmes industriels, lettres ouvertes (WIELS Contemporary Art Center, Brussels, 2021-2022), devoted to Marcel Broodthaers’ Industrial Poems (1968-1972).

1770051.title: Animals
1770051.overview: Still trapped in a doomsday bunker the scientist continues his mission to narrate over footage of the natural world, hoping if animals ever return to this planet they will be cherished.

1770435.title: Cassi
1770435.overview: Cassi is a waitress at a local diner whose life takes a dangerous turn when she romances a reclusive young mortician called Isaac. Their love quickly spirals into a murderous obsession, but with detectives hot on their tail, it forces Isaac to confront how much farther he's willing to go for Cassi.

1773763.title: DNA: The Movie
1773763.overview: Based on Denis Kelly's DNA, a group of troubled teenagers cover up a daunting secret in a haunting way.  Ilyas Sheikh, Josh Bates, Lyla Becker, Ayo O, Elsa Marian Clarke, Charles Egan, and Caoimhe Honey Meddlycott deliver a psychological thriller of the highest order in a tale of twists and turns. The acclaimed play is now converted to a gripping film, teaching of mental collapse and burdensome secrets.
